lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Week 4 — unang Midterm Exams mo sa Senior High. Tahimik ang library, tanging ugong ng electric fan at kaluskos ng yellow pad lang ang maririnig.
lines.textEn: Week 4 — your very first Senior High Midterm Exams. The library is quiet except for the hum of the electric fan and the rustle of yellow pad paper.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, sabay na tayong mag-review sa {strand} majors! Tatlong kape na ako pero kinakabahan pa rin ako sa problem-solving part.
lines.textEn: {name}, let us review for our {strand} majors together! I am on my third cup of coffee and still nervous about the problem-solving section.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Kaya natin 'to, Bea. Hatiin natin ang topics para hindi tayo ma-overload bago mag-alas otso bukas.
lines.textEn: We got this, Bea. Let us split the topics so neither of us burns out before 8 AM tomorrow.

choices.text: Mag-all-nighter review kasama si Bea at mag-share ng reviewer.
choices.textEn: Pull an intense review session with Bea and trade flashcards.

journal.title: SHS 1 Midterms: Review Squad
journal.summary: Nagtulungan kayo ni Bea hanggang gabi at na-ace ang unang midterm sa {strand}.
journal.summaryEn: Teamed up with Bea late into the evening and aced your first {strand} midterms.

choices.text: Mag-focus ng 3 oras tapos matulog nang maaga para fresh ang utak.
choices.textEn: Do a focused 3-hour review then sleep early to stay sharp.

choices.text: Ibenta ang handwritten reviewers mo sa kaklase habang nagre-review.
choices.textEn: Photocopy and sell your neat reviewers to classmates for ₱25 each.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Biyernes ng gabi, habang nagpaplantsa si Mama, napansin mong halos pudpod na ang sapatos mo at may konting tastas na ang kwelyo ng uniform.
lines.textEn: Friday evening while Mama irons your uniform, you notice your school shoes are splitting at the sole and the collar seam is fraying.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, hayaan mo munang tahiin ko 'tong kwelyo. Sa katapusan pa kasi ang maluwag na budget... nakakahiya ba sa mga kaklase mo?
lines.textEn: Let me stitch this collar for now, anak. Our budget won't loosen until month-end... does it embarrass you around classmates?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Hindi po, Ma. Malinis naman at mabango dahil sa inyo. Hindi naman sapatos ang sumasagot sa exam.
lines.textEn: Not at all, Ma. It is clean and pressed because of you. Shoes don't answer the exams anyway.

choices.text: Mag-ipon mula sa sariling raket at ipa-repair sa sapatero sa kanto.
choices.textEn: Spend ₱160 from your own savings at the neighborhood cobbler.

choices.text: Mag-raket muna sa Carinderia para makabili ng matibay na sapatos at pasalubong.
choices.textEn: Take an extra Carinderia shift right now for shoe money and snacks.

choices.text: Gumamit ng rugby glue at ngiti lang — tipid muna para sa finals.
choices.textEn: Patch the sole with shoe glue for now and save every peso.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Huling linggo ng semestre sa Grade 11. Isa-isang tinatawag ni Sir ang mga estudyante sa teacher's table para sa clearance at final project check.
lines.textEn: Final week of Grade 11 semester. Your adviser calls students one by one to the desk for clearance and final project grading.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: {name}, maayos ang attendance mo sa {strand}. Isang oral recitation na lang para ma-lock ang final standing mo ngayong sem.
lines.textEn: {name}, your attendance in {strand} looks solid. One final oral defense question to lock in your semester standing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Huminga ka nang malalim. Alam mong malaki ang magiging epekto nito sa scholarship eligibility mo pagdating ng college.
lines.textEn: You take a deep breath. You know how much your SHS grades matter for future college scholarships.

choices.text: Mag-present nang buo ang kumpiyansa at magbigay ng real-world example.
choices.textEn: Present confidently with a real-life community example.

journal.title: Grade 11 Finals Cleared!
journal.summary: Pumasa ka sa clearance at napabilib si Prof. Reyes sa oral defense mo.
journal.summaryEn: Cleared Grade 11 finals and impressed Prof. Reyes in your oral defense.

choices.text: Mag-volunteer na tumulong sa pag-ayos ng classroom clearance ng iba.
choices.textEn: Volunteer to help organize class portfolios after your turn.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Disyembre na! Kumikislap ang mga parol sa bawat kanto ng {hometown}, at amoy na amoy ang bagong lutong bibingka at puto bumbong sa labas ng simbahan.
lines.textEn: December has arrived! Capiz parol lanterns glow along every corner of {hometown}, and the aroma of freshly steamed puto bumbong fills the cool evening air.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Uy {name}! May lantern-making contest sa school at may ₱500 cash prize para sa section! Sasali ba tayo o tatambay na lang sa bibingkahan?
lines.textEn: Hey {name}! School is holding a parol-making contest with a ₱500 cash prize! Should we join or just chill by the bibingka stall?

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Kung sasali ka {name}, tutulong akong mag-design ng bamboo frame. Masaya 'yun!
lines.textEn: If you join, {name}, I will help design the bamboo frame. It will be fun!

choices.text: Sumali sa Parol Contest kasama sina Jamie at Miggy!
choices.textEn: Enter the Parol Contest with Jamie and Miggy!

choices.text: Ililibre ko na lang sila ng mainit na puto bumbong at tsaa.
choices.textEn: Treat both of them to warm puto bumbong and ginger tea.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Grade 12 na — papalapit na ang State University Entrance Exam! Ang mga kaklase mong may kaya ay naka-enroll sa mamahaling review center.
lines.textEn: Grade 12 — State University Entrance Exams are right around the corner! Wealthier classmates are enrolled in pricey review centers.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Walang pambayad ng review center? Walang problema! Naka-compile ako ng free mock exams at old handouts para sa {course} track natin.
lines.textEn: No budget for a review center? No problem! I compiled free mock exams and donated reviewers tailored for our {course} track.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Barya lang ang pamasahe natin papuntang library, pero libre ang utak at sipag. Game, Bea!
lines.textEn: All it costs is jeepney fare to the library, and grit is free. Let us do this, Bea!

choices.text: Mag-drill ng timed mock exams hanggang ma-perfect ang Math at Science.
choices.textEn: Drill timed mock exams until Math and Science feel automatic.

journal.title: DIY Entrance Exam Warrior
journal.summary: Walang review center pero tinapos mo lahat ng libreng mock exam kasama si Bea.
journal.summaryEn: Skipped pricey review centers and crushed every free mock exam with Bea.

choices.text: Mag-host ng peer tutoring group para kumita habang nagre-review.
choices.textEn: Host a peer tutoring quiz session to earn cash while reviewing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Capstone Research Defense sa Grade 12! Biglang nag-hang ang PowerPoint sa lumang projector habang nakatingin ang tatlong panelist.
lines.textEn: Grade 12 Capstone Research Defense! The old classroom projector freezes mid-slide while three panelists stare expectantly.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Hindi gumagana ang slides, {name}. Kaya mo bang ipaliwanag ang methodology at findings ninyo gamit lang ang blackboard at chalk?
lines.textEn: The slides froze, {name}. Can you defend your methodology and findings using nothing but the chalkboard?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Opo, Sir. Kabisado ko po bawat table dahil kami mismo ang nag-survey sa barangay.
lines.textEn: Yes, Sir. I know every table by heart because we surveyed the barangay ourselves.

choices.text: Dumiretso sa blackboard, iguhit ang data chart, at mag-defend nang walang kopya!
choices.textEn: Step up to the chalkboard, sketch the data chart, and defend from memory!

choices.text: I-distribute ang printed summary sheets (₱180) habang nagpapaliwanag.
choices.textEn: Hand out backup printed handouts (₱180) while walking the panel through.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Palapit na ang Senior High Moving-Up Ceremony! Nilatag ni Tatay sa mesa ang isang lumang alkansya na gawa sa kawayan.
lines.textEn: SHS Graduation is weeks away! Tatay places a worn bamboo coin bank on the dining table.

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Pinag-ipunan namin ng Mama mo 'to barya-barya para sa toga rental, grad pic, at maliit na pansit. Pero kung gusto mong itabi sa college enrollment mo, ikaw ang masusunod.
lines.textEn: Your Mama and I saved coins here for your toga rental, grad photo, and a small tray of pancit. Or if you want to save it for college enrollment, it's your call.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Tay... grabe naman kayo. Hindi ko makakalimutan 'to kahit kailan.
lines.textEn: Tay... I don't even know what to say. I will never forget this.

choices.text: Magpa-picture kasama sina Mama at Tatay at mag-handa ng simple na pansit!
choices.textEn: Take a proud family grad photo and celebrate with homemade pancit!

choices.text: Hiramin ang toga ng pinsan at ilagay lahat ng ₱650 sa College Enrollment Fund!
choices.textEn: Borrow a cousin's toga and put the full ₱650 straight into your College Fund!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Huling hapon bago ang college transition. Nakaupo kayo sa basketball court habang umiinom ng tig-sasampung pisong palamig.
lines.textEn: Last afternoon before college begins. You sit by the barangay court sipping ten-peso iced palamig.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Pre, parang kailan lang nag-aagawan pa tayo ng upuan sa jeep. Ngayon, magko-college ka na sa {course}! Huwag mo kaming kakalimutan ha.
lines.textEn: Bro, feels like yesterday we were racing for jeepney seats. Now you're off to study {course}! Don't forget us, alright?

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Promise natin sa isa't isa: walang susuko kahit gaano kahirap ang college. Sabay-sabay tayong aakyat sa stage!
lines.textEn: Let us promise each other: nobody quits no matter how rough college gets. We all march onto that graduation stage!

choices.text: Itaas ang baso ng palamig: 'Para sa Road to Graduation!'
choices.textEn: Raise your plastic cups of palamig: 'To the Road to Graduation!'

choices.text: Mag-exchange ng emergency contacts at study drive links para connected pa rin.
choices.textEn: Swap emergency contacts and shared study notes for college.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Unang linggo ng totoong buhay-kolehiyo. Maliit ang kwarto, maingay ang busina sa labas, at nanginginig ang clip-on fan sa gilid ng double-deck.
lines.textEn: First real week of college independence. The room is cramped, street traffic hums outside, and a clip-on fan rattles beside the bunk bed.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Oh {name}, eto ang susi at listahan ng rules: curfew 10 PM, hiwalay ang metro ng electric fan, at bawal ang maingay pag may nagre-review.
lines.textEn: Here are your keys and house rules, {name}: 10 PM curfew, separate meter for fans, and quiet hours when anyone is studying.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Copy po, Aling Nena! Sanay po akong magtipid — basta may saksakan at matutulugan, laban na.
lines.textEn: Noted, Aling Nena! I am used to budgeting — as long as there is an outlet and a bed, I am ready.

choices.text: Mag-alok na tumulong sa paglilinis ng hallway para may discount sa water bill.
choices.textEn: Offer to sweep the common hallway on weekends for a utility discount.

choices.text: Ayusin agad ang study corner at mag-call kay Mama para hindi ma-homesick.
choices.textEn: Set up a cozy study corner and video-call Mama before sleeping.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Welcome sa unang College Hell Week! Sabay-sabay ang tatlong major exams sa {course}, dalawang lab reports, at isang surprise quiz.
lines.textEn: Welcome to your first College Hell Week! Three {course} major exams, two lab reports, and a surprise quiz all land in the same 48 hours.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Hindi na ito high school, class. Zero mercy sa late submissions. Kung gusto ninyong makatapos ng {course}, patunayan ninyo ngayong midterms!
lines.textEn: This is not high school anymore, class. Zero mercy for late submissions. If you want that {course} degree, prove it this midterms!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: (Nanginginig na ang kamay ko sa kape... pero hindi ako pwedeng bumagsak dito.)
lines.textEn: (My hands are jittery from instant coffee... but failing here is not an option.)

choices.text: Pumasok sa beast-mode study marathon kasama si Bea hanggang madaling-araw.
choices.textEn: Lock in for a focused dawn study marathon with Bea.

choices.text: Bumili ng brewed coffee at taho (₱90) at mag-pacing ng 2 oras per subject.
choices.textEn: Buy hot taho and coffee (₱90) and pace yourself calmly across subjects.

choices.text: Unahin ang pinakamahirap na major at magpahinga nang sapat para hindi mag-collapse.
choices.textEn: Prioritize the hardest major and protect your sleep so you don't crash.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Mahaba ang pila sa Accounting Office para sa Exam Permit. Hawak mo ang assessment form mo — may balanse ka pang ₱850 bago ka payagang kumuha ng finals.
lines.textEn: The Accounting Office queue for Final Exam Permits snakes down the hallway. Your assessment slip still shows an ₱850 balance.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Uy {name}, kulang ka pa sa permit? May student council desk kami para sa Promissory Note assistance — o kung gusto mo, may urgent shift sa fastfood mamaya!
lines.textEn: Hey {name}, short for your exam permit? Student council helps process Promissory Notes — or there is an urgent fastfood shift tonight!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Salamat, Carlo. Kahit nakakakaba, hahanapan ko ng paraan 'to bago magsara ang cashier.
lines.textEn: Thanks, Carlo. Nerve-wracking as this is, I will find a way before the cashier closes.

choices.text: Bayaran agad ang ₱850 mula sa ipon para wala nang iniisip sa finals.
choices.textEn: Pay the ₱850 balance right now for peace of mind.

choices.text: Mag-file ng Promissory Note sa tulong ni Carlo at nangangakong babayaran next month.
choices.textEn: File a formal Promissory Note with Carlo's Student Council endorsement.

journal.title: Promissory Note Survivor
journal.summary: Na-approve ang exam permit mo sa tulong ng promissory note at student council.
journal.summaryEn: Secured your finals permit through a student council-backed promissory note.

choices.text: Kunin ang urgent Fastfood Crew shift ngayon para mabuo ang pambayad!
choices.textEn: Take the urgent Fastfood Crew shift right now to cover the permit!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Golden sunset sa University Belt. Katatapos lang ng huling final exam mo sa First Year! Bumubuhos palabas ng gate ang mga estudyanteng parang nabunutan ng tinik.
lines.textEn: Golden sunset along the University Belt. You just walked out of your final Freshman exam as hundreds of relieved students pour past the campus gates.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: We survived Freshman Year, {name}! Isipin mo 'yun — nakaya mong pagsabayin ang {course}, budget, at pamasahe!
lines.textEn: We survived Freshman Year, {name}! Think about that — you juggled {course}, tight budgets, and daily commutes!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Unang baitang pa lang 'to, Jamie. Tatlong taon na lang — sabay tayong gagraduate.
lines.textEn: Just the first step, Jamie. Three years left — we are both walking across that stage.

choices.text: Mag-celebrate sa kwek-kwek at fishball stall sa kanto kasama si Jamie!
choices.textEn: Celebrate over street-food kwek-kwek and iced gulaman with Jamie!

choices.text: Umuwi nang maaga at mag-plan ng summer raket para sa Second Year tuition.
choices.textEn: Head home early and plan a summer side hustle for Year 2 tuition.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Sophomore year na — oras na para sa Campus Org Fair! May banner ang student organization ng {course} at kumakaway si Carlo mula sa booth.
lines.textEn: Sophomore year brings the Campus Org Fair! The {course} student society booth is bustling, and Carlo waves you over.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: {name}! Kailangan namin ng Finance Officer para sa Foundation Week. Maganda 'to sa resume at may free meal stubs tuwing events — pero busy ang schedule!
lines.textEn: {name}! We need a Finance Officer for Foundation Week. Great for your resume plus free event meal stubs — though it eats into your free time!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Sanay na akong mag-budget ng barya, Carlo... kaya siguro kaya kong hawakan ang org funds!
lines.textEn: I budget coins every single day, Carlo... I think I can handle an org spreadsheet!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang Finance Officer role — para sa resume at leadership!
choices.textEn: Accept the Finance Officer role for leadership experience and free meal stubs!

journal.title: Org Finance Officer
journal.summary: Nahalal ka bilang Finance Officer ng {course} org sa 2nd Year.
journal.summaryEn: Became Finance Officer of the {course} student organization in Sophomore Year.

choices.text: Maging volunteer lang muna para hindi mapabayaan ang GWA at part-time work.
choices.textEn: Stay as a casual volunteer to protect your GWA and work hours.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 2nd Year Midterms — kilala bilang 'weeding-out semester' sa {course}. Nakatulala si Bea sa malamig niyang siomai rice sa canteen.
lines.textEn: Sophomore Midterms — infamous as the 'weeding-out semester' in {course}. Bea stares blankly at her cold siomai rice in the canteen.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Guys, first time kong makakuha ng 2.50 sa quiz... feeling ko hindi ko na kayang i-maintain ang Dean's List.
lines.textEn: Guys, I just got my first 2.50 on a quiz... I feel like I am slipping off the Dean's List.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Huy, tao ka pa rin, Bea! Kahit si {name} napapagod din. Anong plano natin ngayong linggo para walang ma-burnout sa atin?
lines.textEn: Hey, you're human, Bea! Even {name} gets exhausted. What is our game plan this week so none of us burn out?

choices.text: Mag-organize ng chill study-and-merienda night sa boarding house.
choices.textEn: Host a relaxed study-and-merienda session at your boarding house.

choices.text: I-comfort si Bea at mag-pair review sa pinakamahirap niyang subject.
choices.textEn: Comfort Bea and pair-study her toughest subject together.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pangalawang semestre ng Sophomore Year. Marami sa mga blockmates mo ang nag-drop o nag-shift ng course dahil sa hirap ng majors at gastos.
lines.textEn: Second semester of Sophomore Year. Several blockmates have dropped out or shifted courses due to brutal majors and rising costs.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: {name}, kumusta ka na? Nakita ko ang trabaho mo — may grit ka, pero alam kong mabigat ang gastusin. Sigurado ka bang itutuloy mo ang {course} hanggang dulo?
lines.textEn: {name}, how are you holding up? I see your grit, and I know finances are heavy. Are you sure you want to stay the course in {course}?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Mahirap po, Sir... minsan naiiyak ako sa jeep. Pero bawat sakripisyo ng pamilya ko sa {hometown}, dito nakasalalay.
lines.textEn: It is tough, Sir... sometimes I tear up on the jeepney. But my family's sacrifices in {hometown} are riding on this.

choices.text: 'Itutuloy ko po ang {course}, Sir. Kahit barya-barya, lalaban ako!'
choices.textEn: 'I am finishing {course}, Sir. Even coin by coin, I will see it through!'

choices.text: Humingi ng rekomendasyon kay Prof. Reyes para sa departmental student assistantship!
choices.textEn: Ask Prof. Reyes to endorse you for a paid student assistantship!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bukas na ang Mid-Degree Scholarship Revalidation! Kahit hindi ka pa scholar o active scholar ka na, may bagong grant slots para sa mga consistent students.
lines.textEn: Mid-Degree Scholarship Revalidation is open! Whether you already hold a grant or want to apply fresh, new slots just opened for consistent students.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, sayang 'tong opportunity! Kung maipapasa mo ang documents at interview ngayon, malaking ginhawa 'yan pagdating ng 3rd Year tuition!
lines.textEn: {name}, do not miss this chance! Passing the documents and interview today will be a massive relief when Year 3 tuition hits!

choices.text: Sumabak ngayon sa Scholarship Application Quest!
choices.textEn: Enter the Scholarship Application Quest right now!

choices.text: Mag-focus muna sa final exam reviewers para siguradong mataas ang GWA.
choices.textEn: Focus on final exam reviewers first to guarantee a stellar GWA.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Junior Year — nagsisimula na ang pre-OJT at internship screening para sa mga {course} students! Suot mo ang pinakamaayos mong polo habang nakaupo sa harap ng hiring manager.
lines.textEn: Junior Year — pre-OJT and internship screening has begun for {course} students! You sit upright in your sharpest shirt across from a hiring manager.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Impressive ang story mo, {name}. Nag-aaral ka ng {course} habang kumakayod. Ang tanong ko: bakit ka namin kukunin kahit wala ka pang corporate experience?
lines.textEn: Your story is impressive, {name} — studying {course} while supporting yourself. Tell me: why should we hire you without prior corporate experience?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Dahil sanay po akong matuto nang mabilis sa totoong buhay. Hindi po ako takot sa trabaho, at hindi ako umaatras sa deadline.
lines.textEn: Because real life already taught me to learn fast under pressure. I am not afraid of hard work, and I never miss a deadline.

choices.text: Ipakita ang portfolio ng projects at part-time raket experience mo!
choices.textEn: Showcase your projects portfolio and real-world part-time experience!

journal.title: Paid Internship Offer!
journal.summary: Napabilib mo ang interviewer at nakakuha ng paid OJT allowance sa 3rd Year!
journal.summaryEn: Impressed the hiring panel and landed a paid internship allowance in Year 3!

choices.text: Humingi ng flexible hours para mapagsabay ang majors at OJT.
choices.textEn: Negotiate flexible hours so you can balance majors and OJT.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Title Defense para sa College Thesis! Dalawang beses nang na-reject ang mga naunang topic ng grupo ninyo — ito na ang huling pitch slot bago ang deadline.
lines.textEn: College Thesis Title Defense! Two earlier topic proposals were rejected — this is your final pitch slot before the department deadline.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Kailangan ng praktikal na solusyon para sa totoong komunidad, {name}. Ano ang huling title proposal ng grupo ninyo sa {course}?
lines.textEn: I need a practical solution for a real community problem, {name}. What is your group's final thesis pitch for {course}?

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: (Bulong) {name}, gamitin natin 'yung idea mo tungkol sa {hometown}! Malakas ang impact nun!
lines.textEn: (Whispers) {name}, pitch your idea inspired by {hometown}! It has real heart and impact!

choices.text: I-pitch ang community-impact thesis na hango sa totoong karanasan mo sa {hometown}!
choices.textEn: Pitch a community-impact thesis rooted in real challenges from {hometown}!

journal.title: Thesis Title Approved!
journal.summary: Naaprubahan nang walang revision ang community-based thesis title ninyo!
journal.summaryEn: Your community-impact thesis title passed with zero major revisions!

choices.text: I-pitch ang safe at low-budget research study para hindi mabigat sa bulsa.
choices.textEn: Pitch a lean, low-cost research study to keep printing and data costs down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alas-diyes ng gabi. Nag-ring ang phone mo — video call mula kay Mama. Maputla ang mukha niya at nasa likod si Tatay na nakahiga sa katre.
lines.textEn: 10 PM. Your phone rings — a video call from Mama. She looks tired, and behind her Tatay rests quietly on the bed.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Huwag ka mag-alala nang sobra, {name}... nilagnat lang si Tatay at kailangan ng gamot sa clinic. Kaya pa naman namin, pero baka ma-delay ang padala ko sa'yo ng isang linggo.
lines.textEn: Don't panic, {name}... Tatay came down with a fever and needed clinic medicine. We will manage, though I might have to delay next week's allowance.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Ma, kalimutan muna ang baon ko! Ang mahalaga gumaling agad si Tatay.
lines.textEn: Ma, forget my allowance! What matters is Tatay getting better right away.

choices.text: Magpadala ng ₱600 pambili ng gamot at prutas ni Tatay kahit gipit ka.
choices.textEn: Send ₱600 home for Tatay's medicine and fruit even if your wallet hurts.

journal.title: Padala Para Kay Tatay
journal.summary: Ikaw naman ang tumulong sa pamilya mo nang magkasakit si Tatay sa 3rd Year.
journal.summaryEn: Stepped up to send medicine money home when Tatay fell ill in Year 3.

choices.text: Sabihin kay Mama na okay ka lang at mag-extra raket ka ngayong gabi!
choices.textEn: Reassure Mama you are covered and jump into a part-time shift tonight!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: College Innovation & Skills Expo! Nakadisplay ang proyekto ng mga 3rd Year {course} students sa covered court habang naglilibot ang mga alumni judges.
lines.textEn: College Innovation & Skills Expo! Year 3 {course} projects line the covered court while alumni judges walk booth to booth.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: {name}! May alumni sponsor na naghahanap ng Best Practical Project — ₱1,000 cash grant para sa panalo!
lines.textEn: {name}! An alumni sponsor is awarding a ₱1,000 cash grant for Best Practical Project!

choices.text: Mag-live demo nang buong sigla sa harap ng mga alumni judges!
choices.textEn: Deliver an energetic live demo right in front of the alumni judges!

choices.text: Makipag-network sa mga alumni para sa future job referrals pag-graduate.
choices.textEn: Network warmly with alumni mentors for post-graduation referrals.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Senior Year — Recto printing shops at alas-onse ng gabi! Nakapila ang mga graduating students para sa hardbound thesis printing bago ang defense week.
lines.textEn: Senior Year — Recto printing shops at 11 PM! Exhausted graduating seniors queue for hardbound thesis copies before defense week.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, ₱650 ang rush printing at hardbound ng kopya natin... tapos nakita ko pa na may typo sa Table 3.2! I-edit pa ba natin?
lines.textEn: {name}, rush printing and binding is ₱650... and I just spotted a typo in Table 3.2! Do we fix it right now?

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: I-edit natin! Isang beses lang tayo mag-de-defense sa buhay natin — gawin nating malinis.
lines.textEn: Fix it now! We only defend this thesis once — let us make it spotless.

choices.text: I-fix ang typo, bayaran ang rush hardbound (₱650), at i-proofread hanggang umaga!
choices.textEn: Fix the typo, pay ₱650 for rush binding, and proofread till sunrise!

choices.text: Makiusap sa kuya sa print shop ng student discount at mag-share ng gastos sa grupo.
choices.textEn: Politely negotiate a student discount and split costs evenly with the team.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Comprehensive Exam Week para sa mga 4th Year {course} candidates! Apat na oras na sunod-sunod na pagsusulit na sumasaklaw mula First Year hanggang Fourth Year.
lines.textEn: Comprehensive Exam Week for Year 4 {course} candidates! Four straight hours covering everything from Freshman fundamentals to Senior mastery.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Lahat ng pinagpuyatan ninyo sa nakaraang apat na taon, dito masusubok. Good luck, {name}. Ipakita mo ang kaya ng isang iskolar na lumaban sa bawat barya.
lines.textEn: Every late night over the past four years comes down to this. Good luck, {name}. Show them what a resilient student can do.

choices.text: Huminga nang malalim at sagutan bawat item nang kalmado at sistematiko.
choices.textEn: Breathe steadily and work through every problem methodically.

journal.title: Comprehensive Exam Passed!
journal.summary: Naipasa mo ang 4-year comprehensive exam sa {course} nang may dignidad!
journal.summaryEn: Passed the 4-year {course} comprehensive exam with flying colors!

choices.text: Tapusin ang exam nang mabilis at i-double check lahat ng mahihirap na items.
choices.textEn: Pace aggressively to leave 45 minutes for double-checking hard questions.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: May pumasok na email notification sa phone mo habang nag-aayos ng clearance: 'CONDITIONAL FULL-TIME OFFER — {course} Graduate Trainee'!
lines.textEn: An email notification chimes on your phone while processing clearance: 'CONDITIONAL FULL-TIME OFFER — {course} Graduate Trainee'!

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Congratulations, {name}! Naalala ka namin sa OJT at campus expo. Basta makuha mo ang diploma mo ngayong sem, may trabaho ka na agad next month — plus ₱1,200 signing bonus!
lines.textEn: Congratulations, {name}! We remembered your hustle from OJT and the campus expo. Earn that diploma this semester and the role is yours — plus a ₱1,200 early stipend!

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Totoo po ba 'to?! Ma, Tay... malapit na po tayong makabawi!
lines.textEn: Is this real?! Ma, Tay... we are finally about to turn the page!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang offer at magpasalamat — ipambabayad agad sa natitirang graduation fees!
choices.textEn: Accept the conditional offer and put the ₱1,200 toward graduation clearance!

journal.title: May Job Offer Bago Pa Mag-Graduate!
journal.summary: Nakatanggap ka ng full-time graduate offer habang tinatapos ang huling semestre mo!
journal.summaryEn: Landed a full-time graduate offer before even walking the graduation stage!

choices.text: Tanggapin at ilibre sina Aling Nena at ang barkada ng pansit bilang pasasalamat!
choices.textEn: Accept and treat Aling Nena and your barkada to a celebratory pancit feast!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rehearsal sa auditorium at toga fitting! Mula sa {hometown}, lumuwas nang maaga sina Mama at Tatay na may dalang sampaguita at bagong plantsang barong.
lines.textEn: Graduation rehearsal and toga fitting! Mama and Tatay traveled early from {hometown} carrying sampaguita garlands and their finest Sunday clothes.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, patingin nga... bagay na bagay sa'yo ang toga mo! Parang kahapon lang barya-barya pa ang inaabot ko sa'yo sa umaga...
lines.textEn: Let me look at you, anak... that toga fits you so proudly! It feels like just yesterday I was handing you loose coins at 5:30 AM...

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Ipinagmamalaki ka namin, {name}. Kahit anong medalya o wala, panalo ka na sa puso namin.
lines.textEn: We are so proud of you, {name}. Medal or no medal, you already won in our hearts.

choices.text: Isuot kay Mama at Tatay ang toga mo para sa pinakamagandang picture sa buhay mo.
choices.textEn: Drape your toga over Mama and Tatay for the most precious photo of your life.

choices.text: Yakapin sila nang mahigpit: 'Para sa inyo po itong diploma, Ma at Tay!'
choices.textEn: Hug them tightly: 'This diploma belongs to both of you, Ma and Tay!'
